headline: Two contrasts on the same 5-fold design calibrate the benchmark: an 8.1% effect (remove the time channel) reproduces at 260 engines, a 0.9% effect (bounded time encoding) does not, and the single 80/20 split overstated both (2.4x and 7x) with three agreeing seeds each time.
